finding.text: The new index page /framework/core/Page/content/ says "Every child below is one shape of page content", but nothing is below: its 13 children (Code, String 1-5, Address 1-5, both, class-body) appear only in the sidebar, so the page tells instead of shows and stands 68–88% empty (page 1, content: show, don't tell). Evidence: shots/…-framework-core-Page-content/sheet.png, every width. Fix: list the children on the page as cards or links.

The sidebar lists "Page content, ever…" three times under Page (after Parts, and twice after Audit) (navigation: one entry per page). Evidence: shots/…-framework-core-Page-content-both/1200.png, left rail. The new page is declared once in `core/Page/page.js` `children`, so either the strings/addresses children are being titled from their parent, or the page is registered more than once.

On /content/both/ the `page.jsonl` paragraph is drawn as a white card at 1200 but as plain text at 1920 and 3440. Evidence: shots/…-content-both/1200.png vs 1920.png. The row gets `.card` because `part-text` has no View. Same item, two looks, depending on width.

The proof of "screenshots match" rests on STATE.md's claim that 10 screenshot diffs and 18 text diffs are noise (the old code shows them against itself as well). That is plausible, and the targeted A/B on the suspect pages matched, but the diff does not include the baseline artefacts, so this review could not check it.
/framework/core/Page/ still wraps its tab bar to 3 rows at 1200 (layout.json tab_rows 3) and 2 rows at 1920. The same wrap shows before this change, so it is not a regression.

`take_content()` sets `_content = undefined`, so on a page `ext/catalog` touches, `page.content` stops being "the same List for the page's life" (requirement 1). That is fine for now, but the doc should say so: content-list-step-1.md, under "Callers".

content.md step 1 is marked with a "Built 2026-10-12 (step 1 only)" banner above the design, not ticked on the "Order" line (line 38) where the steps are listed (requirement 4). A reader of the order line can't see that step 1 is done.

On /framework/core/Page/content-shapes/both/, the jsonl line draws as a white card at 1200 and as plain text at 1920 (shots/…-content-shapes-both/sheet.png). STATE.md records that this behaviour was already there before (`part-text` has no View of its own). It is still the demo of the new ability, so it should look the same at every width.

The content-shapes index is a list of 12 links in one narrow column, 83% empty at 3440 (layout.json `empty` 0.834). It tells you what each shape is but doesn't show it (content 1). A live render of each shape beside its link would make the point at a glance.

/alex/examples/subpage/nested/ shows "Page Load Error / 404" at every width. This already happened before the change: no parent's `children:` names the page, so nothing routes to it. The changed line `this.content.render()` is never reached there.

Problems that were already there and are not caused by this diff: the /framework/core/Page/ tab bar wraps to 3 rows at 1200 (layout.json tab_rows 3), and the /framework/ai/2026-08-17/report/ prose runs to 1107px at 1920 and 1245px at 3440 (widest_text), past the reading measure.
